text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d the i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d s-t-o-c-k to c-o-v-e-r the f-a-i-l-e-d a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y r-e-s-u-l-t and l-e-f-t a m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d p-a-c-k-a-g-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-m-p-a-r-a-t-i-v-e t-e-s-t.
2) the actor f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d the s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n t-a-g-s to m-a-s-k the o-r-i-g-i-n and l-e-f-t a t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d i-d l-i-s-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
3) the actor a-l-t-e-r-e-d the c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n l-o-g-s to s-h-o-w s-t-a-b-l-e t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e-s and l-e-f-t f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d s-e-n-s-o-r r-e-a-d-i-n-g-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the q-u-a-l-i-t-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) the actor d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d the i-t-e-m-s to p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y-c-a-n-a-l s and l-e-f-t a d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-h-i-r-d p-a-r-t-y a-u-d-i-t.
5) the actor c-l-o-s-e-d the m-a-t-t-e-r w-i-t-h-o-u-t n-o-t-i-f-y-i-n-g the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-s and l-e-f-t a m-i-s-l-e-d-g-e-r r-e-c-o-r-d w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-u-t-y t-o w-a-r-n.
